connectorUiConfig.title: WhoisFreaks Threat Intelligence (using Azure Functions)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The WhoisFreaks data connector ingests WhoisFreaks threat intelligence and newly registered domain feeds into Microsoft Sentinel through an Azure Function and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. The solution supports malware, phishing, spam, and NRD feeds.

**Installing this Content Hub solution registers the connector UI only.** It does not create the Function App, storage account, Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rule, or custom tables. After installing, use the **Deploy to Azure** button in the instructions below to deploy that infrastructure -- that deployment is where you provide your WhoisFreaks API key and choose which feeds to enable. You can change feed enable/disable flags afterwards in the Function App application settings (`WHOISFREAKS_FEED_*_ENABLED`).

| summarize count() by Type

instructionSteps.description: >**NOTE:** This connector uses an Azure Function and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. Azure Functions and Log Analytics ingestion can incur Azure charges.

Installing this solution from Content Hub registers the connector UI only -- it does not create any Azure resources. Click **Deploy to Azure** below to deploy the Function App, storage account, Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rule and the 7 custom Log Analytics tables into the same resource group as this Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

[![Deploy To Azure](https://aka.ms/deploytoazurebutton)](https://portal.azure.com/#create/Microsoft.Template/uri/https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FAzure%2FAzure-Sentinel%2Fmaster%2FSolutions%2FWhoisFreaks%2Fazuredeploy%2Fazuredeploy.json)

properties.query:
let Threat =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (WhoisFreaksMalware_CL
            | extend FeedName = "malware", FeedCategory = "ThreatIntelligence"),
        (WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL
            | extend FeedName = "phishing", FeedCategory = "ThreatIntelligence"),
        (WhoisFreaksSpam_CL
            | extend FeedName = "spam", FeedCategory = "ThreatIntelligence")
    | extend
        Domain = tolower(trim(" ", coalesce(tostring(domain), tostring(domain_name), ""))),
        ThreatType = tostring(coalesce(threat_type, FeedName)),
        Confidence = todouble(confidence),
        FirstSeen = todatetime(first_seen),
        LastSeen = todatetime(last_seen),
        ThreatPivotCount = toint(No_of_threat_matched_pivots),
        CreateDate = datetime(null),
        RegistrarName = "",
        RegistrantName = "",
        RegistrantCompany = "",
        RegistrantCountry = "",
        RegistrantEmail = ""
    | where isnotempty(Domain);
let NrdWithWhois =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL
            | extend FeedName = "nrd_gtld_with_whois", FeedCategory = "NewlyRegisteredDomain"),

properties.description:
Matches WhoisFreaks malware, phishing, or spam domains against DNS, proxy, firewall, and email telemetry.
A hit indicates a host or user in the environment contacted a domain listed by WhoisFreaks as malicious.
properties.displayName: WhoisFreaks - Threat domain observed in environment
properties.query:
let lookback = 14d;
let ti =
    union isfuzzy=true
        WhoisFreaksMalware_CL,
        WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL,
        WhoisFreaksSpam_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", coalesce(tostring(domain), tostring(domain_name), "")))
    | where isnotempty(Domain)
    | summarize
        ThreatType = any(tostring(coalesce(threat_type, ""))),
        Confidence = max(todouble(confidence)),
        FirstSeen = min(todatetime(first_seen)),
        LastSeen = max(todatetime(last_seen)),
        FeedTables = make_set(Type)
      by Domain;
let dns =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (DnsEvents
            | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(Name))), SrcIp = tostring(ClientIP), Device = tostring(Computer)),
        (CommonSecurityLog
            | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
            | where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(RequestURL)
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", coalesce(
                  tostring(DestinationHostName),
                  tostring(parse_url(tostring(RequestURL)).Host),
                  "")))
            | extend SrcIp = tostring(SourceIP), Device = tostring(Computer)),
        (DeviceNetworkEvents
            | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
            | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host)))
            | extend SrcIp = tostring(LocalIP), Device = tostring(DeviceName)),
        (EmailUrlInfo
            | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
            | where isnotempty(UrlDomain)
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(UrlDomain)))
            | extend SrcIp = "", Device = "")
    | where isnotempty(Domain)
    | summarize
        EventCount = count(),
        FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
        LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated),
        SrcIps = make_set(SrcIp, 20),
        Devices = make_set(Device, 20)
      by Domain;
ti
| join kind=inner dns on Domain
| project
    TimeGenerated = LastEvent,
    Domain,
    ThreatType,
    Confidence,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    EventCount,
    FirstEvent,
    LastEvent,
    SrcIps,
    Devices,
    FeedTables

properties.description: WhoisFreaks_NRD_Contact_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Detects internal hosts contacting a domain that appears in WhoisFreaks newly registered domain (NRD) feeds
and was registered within the last N days (default 7). Newly registered domains are frequently used in
phishing and malware campaigns shortly after registration.
properties.displayName: WhoisFreaks - Contact with newly registered domain
properties.query:
let nrd_age_days = 7d;
let nrd =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(domain_name))),
                     CreateDate = todatetime(create_date),
                     Registrar = tostring(domain_registrar_name)),
        (WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(domain_name))),
                     CreateDate = todatetime(create_date),
                     Registrar = tostring(domain_registrar_name)),
        (WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(domain_name))),
                     CreateDate = datetime(null),
                     Registrar = ""),
        (WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(domain_name))),
                     CreateDate = datetime(null),
                     Registrar = "")
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)
    | where isnotempty(Domain)
    | where isnull(CreateDate) or CreateDate >= ago(nrd_age_days)
    | summarize
        CreateDate = min(CreateDate),
        Registrar = any(Registrar),
        FeedTables = make_set(Type)
      by Domain;
let dns =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (DnsEvents
            | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(Name))), SrcIp = tostring(ClientIP), Device = tostring(Computer)),
        (CommonSecurityLog
            | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
            | where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(RequestURL)
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", coalesce(
                  tostring(DestinationHostName),
                  tostring(parse_url(tostring(RequestURL)).Host),
                  "")))
            | extend SrcIp = tostring(SourceIP), Device = tostring(Computer)),
        (DeviceNetworkEvents
            | where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
            | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host)))
            | extend SrcIp = tostring(LocalIP), Device = tostring(DeviceName))
    | where isnotempty(Domain)
    | summarize
        EventCount = count(),
        FirstEvent = min(TimeGenerated),
        LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated),
        SrcIps = make_set(SrcIp, 20),
        Devices = make_set(Device, 20)
      by Domain;
nrd
| join kind=inner dns on Domain
| project
    TimeGenerated = LastEvent,
    Domain,
    CreateDate,
    Registrar,
    EventCount,
    FirstEvent,
    LastEvent,
    SrcIps,
    Devices,
    FeedTables

properties.query:
let lookback = 7d;
let ti =
    union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
    | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", coalesce(tostring(domain), tostring(domain_name), "")))

      by Domain;
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(lookback)
| extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(Name)))
| where isnotempty(Domain)
| summarize
    QueryCount = count(),
    Clients = make_set(ClientIP, 50),
    FirstQuery = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastQuery = max(TimeGenerated)

        (WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(domain_name))), CreateDate = todatetime(create_date)),
        (WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(domain_name))), CreateDate = datetime(null)),
        (WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL
            | extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(domain_name))), CreateDate = datetime(null))
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
    | where isnotempty(Domain)
    | where isnull(CreateDate) or CreateDate >= ago(nrd_age)

CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)

      tostring(parse_url(tostring(RequestURL)).Host),

| where isnotempty(Domain)

    Sources = make_set(SourceIP, 30),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
  by Domain, DeviceName
| join kind=inner nrd on Domain
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Domain, CreateDate, DeviceName, Sources, Hits

Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The WhoisFreaks solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests WhoisFreaks threat intelligence and newly registered domain feeds through an Azure Function and the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. The solution includes a unified KQL parser, analytics rules for TI and NRD matches, hunting queries, and an overview workbook.
